title: Dubai opens a free, AED 2.5 million global championship for AI-agent builders

claims.text: Dubai has launched the Create AI Agents Championship, a global competition for practical and scalable AI-agent solutions to real-world challenges, with a total prize pool of more than AED 2.5 million.
claims.label: Prize pool

claims.text: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, announced the launch and invited innovators from across the world.
The organiser says the championship shifts the focus from developing digital applications to creating autonomous AI-agent systems built for real user needs and market requirements.
The championship is part of the Create Apps in Dubai initiative, led by the Dubai Chamber of Digital Economy to support app development, digital skills and technology entrepreneurship.
It has four core categories: Best Societal AI Agent, Best Personal AI Agent, Best Business AI Agent and Best Youth AI Agent.
claims.label: Core categories

claims.text: The Best Societal category recognises agents that strengthen social cohesion and inclusion and support education, sustainability and social resilience.
The Best Business category recognises agents that help public and private organisations improve workflows, services, decision-making and customer experience.
One of the four category winners will also receive the title of Dubai AI Agent of the Year.
Participants create an AI agent prototype, a pitch deck and a demo video, and 24 teams move forward to pitch in the semi-final.
claims.label: Semi-finalist teams

claims.text: The Digital Academy offers 10 short videos that explain AI agents without requiring a technical background.
claims.label: Academy videos

claims.text: Participants also get access to workshops, specialised sessions and mentorship.
Participation in the championship is free of charge.
